ALLOCATION FRAMING CORRECTED FROM THE STATUTE, and this is the important one. The four cumulative conditions (including 'the buyer asked') come from s.47(a2)(1), which is the SELLER'S DUTY trigger. s.38(a1) bars the BUYER'S input-VAT deduction with NO buyer-request condition. Telling a validator 'do not flag a document that fails any of them' therefore passes every above-threshold invoice the customer forgot to ask about, and the customer silently loses the deduction. Both rules are now stated separately, with the statute text in references/api-reference.md.
THRESHOLD BOUNDARY SETTLED: s.38(a1) says עולה על (exceeds), so an invoice at exactly the threshold is outside the rule. Vendor summaries split between 'ומעלה' and 'עולה על'; the statute governs.

OSEK PATUR ROUTED TO A TAX INVOICE (critical). Troubleshooting and Workflow 1 both told an osek patur to issue type 320. Type 320 IS a חשבונית מס, and s.47(a) reserves the right to issue one to an עוסק מורשה. Corrected to 300 / 400 / 20 in both languages and in the reference.

INCOME-ROW VAT TABLE PRINTED THE DOCUMENT ENUM (critical). SKILL.md and SKILL_HE.md gave ItemVatType as 1=Exempt, 2=Mixed; the spec is 0 default, 1 INCLUDED in price, 2 exempt. The paragraph directly above stated the correct values and warned against exactly this, so the file contradicted itself and the wrong table was the one an agent reads first. A row meant as exempt would have been issued VAT-inclusive.

SCRIPT COULD NOT RUN ITS HEADLINE COMMAND (critical). The income row omitted vatType and the payment row omitted date, both required by IncomeRowRequest / PaymentRowRequest. Added, with date defaulting to today.

SCRIPT OVER-PAID EVERY OSEK-PATUR AND EVERY ZERO-RATED DOCUMENT (critical). The gross was derived as net*(1+18%) for any document vatType other than 1, so an osek patur invoice got an 11,800 payment against a 10,000 total, and the skill's own documented zero-rated export flow could not be expressed at all. Added --osek-patur and --row-vat-type, and keyed the derivation on the row rate too. All four branches retested.

FABRICATIONS AGAINST THE VENDOR'S OWN OPENAPI, found by probing developers.morning.co/docs/openapi.bundled.json: the allocation-number field IS documented as `allocationNumber` (the skill sent users on a reverse-engineering hunt); the webhook signature scheme IS documented as x-webhook-signature HMAC-SHA256 hex over the raw body (the skill said it was undocumented, which invites skipping verification); `subAppType` does not exist and PaymentAppType 2 is Pay, not Pepper Pay; PluginType has no 12050 Payoneer and 12130 is Grow, not Meshulam; the Composer package mordisacks/greeninvoice 404s; wss://wss.greeninvoice.co.il appears in no source.

MISSING ENUM ROWS: PaymentTerm had 5 of 10 rows and mislabelled -1/0 as immediate/end-of-month when the spec says מיידי/שוטף (שוטף+30 is not end-of-month+30); CreditCardType was missing 0 Unknown; CreditCardDealType was missing 6 Recurring; OtherSubType stopped at 3 of 8; DocumentType was 13 of 15, and the bundled script hard-rejected types 20 and 410 so it could not create a donation cancellation.

PAGINATION WAS 0-BASED throughout the examples and the script while SearchDocumentsRequest.page defaults to 1, and the script relabelled page 0 as 'page 1'. Any full-year VAT reconciliation would drop or duplicate a page.

SECTION 46 IS A זיכוי, NOT A ניכוי. Workflow 8 called it a 'tax deduction (35%)'; it is a credit at 35% for an individual and at the s.126(a) rate for a company, with a floor, a ceiling and a carry-forward. SKILL.md Step 10 already said 'credit', so the skill contradicted itself.

TYPE 405 IS NOT GATED TO BUSINESS TYPE 4. The spec attaches no business-type constraint, and s.9(2) defines מוסד ציבורי as a חבר בני אדם, which covers a חברה לתועלת הציבור (business type 5). The claim would have told a חל"צ its donation-receipt path was closed.
